children: INBRX-106, a hexavalent OX40 agonist, showed superior efficacy to pembrolizumab alone in first-line recurrent/metastatic HNSCC, especially in HPV+ patients, with higher response rates and improved progression-free survival. It had a favorable safety profile and is being expanded for accelerated approval, with potential in other immunogenic tumors and with cancer vaccines.
